description: Start here for discovery: search FrontRowTickets.com ticket inventory by free text, city, date range, and category (sports, concerts, theater, comedy). All filters are optional and combine freely; returns up to 'limit' events (default 10, max 50, no further pages), soonest first, with ticket counts and starting prices. Use get_event for one event's full record, get_deals when the user has a hard budget cap.

category.description: One of sports, concerts, theater, comedy

query.description: Free text: team, artist, show, or venue name

name: search_events
